title: Tempura Cauliflower in Miso Sauce
subtitle: a vegetarian General Tso's style
description: Cauliflower florets in a light beer batter, deep fried and tossed in a sticky miso, soy and chilli sauce. A vegetarian take on the Chinese-American classic.

steps.text: Steam the whole cauliflower for 5-6 minutes, until the florets change colour and soften slightly. Remove, cool for 2-3 minutes and cut into bite-sized florets.
Mix the self-raising flour, cornflour and salt in a bowl. Gradually add the beer or soda, stirring, to make a thick but not too thick batter (you may not need all of it).
Heat oil for deep frying in a small pot. Dip the florets in the batter and fry for 3-4 minutes in 2-3 batches until golden. Drain on paper towel.
Heat a little oil in a wide pan and stir-fry the sliced garlic, ginger, white part of the spring onions and chilli for about 30 seconds until starting to soften.
Add the soy sauce, miso, vinegar, date syrup and water, stir and bring to the boil.
Add the cauliflower and the green part of the spring onions and toss for about half a minute until coated. Add more water or soy sauce if there is not enough sauce. Serve immediately.
